senses.gloss: m. ch. = h.חֵמָר , asphalt (from its dark color, Ges. H. Dict.10 s. v.), used as cement.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 2:3">Targ. Ex. II, 3</cite>.—Targ. II Esth. III, 3 <he>וריחא דגלגלוי כחוּמָרָא</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>וריחא לגלוי בחו׳</he>, read: <he>דגַלּוֹי כח׳</he>) and the odor of its billows is like that of asphalt.
